# Rimbo — Digital Loyalty Platform

> Rimbo is a SaaS loyalty platform for small and medium businesses in Ukraine — coffee shops, bakeries, restaurants, barbershops, beauty salons, fitness studios, pet services, auto services and hotels. It provides digital stamp cards, bonuses, cashback, tiered discounts, promo codes, gift cards, and smart coupons — all managed from a single dashboard.

## Key Features
- Google Wallet & Apple Wallet integration
- QR-code scanning for stamp/bonus accrual
- Push notifications
- Live analytics across multiple locations
- POS integration (Poster, Checkbox)
- Team access with role-based permissions
- Full API for custom integrations
- White-label card design

## Pricing (UAH/month)
- Growth: 799/mo (699 annual)
- Pro: 1399/mo (1199 annual) — most popular
- Business: 1999/mo (1699 annual)
- 14-day free trial on all plans
